import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix label variants and whitespace
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().replace({'chinstrap': 'Chinstrap'})
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    # Convert text-encoded numbers to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    # Remove out-of-range body masses
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = float('nan')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Drop rows with missing sex or missing/invalid body mass
    sub = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    sub = sub[sub['sex'].isin(['male', 'female'])]
    result = sub.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    # Ensure plain float values
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in result.items()}
